title: Results from Measures to Reduce Waiting Time for Admissions to Public Hospitals
what_it_is: Results from Measures to Reduce Waiting Time for Admissions to Public Hospitals

sections.label: Hospital bed waiting times
sections.summary: The Minister for Health was asked about waiting time results, longest projected bed waits, mobilising private hospitals, and care for patients not admitted within a day.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) when can the results from the measures announced to reduce waiting time for admissions to public hospitals be expected; (b) what is the longest projected waiting time for beds; (c) when will the Ministry start to mobilise private hospitals and healthcare facilities; and (d) what steps have been taken to ensure that patients who are not admitted within a day receive timely and quality care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This translates into 15% more utilisation of hospital beds and is the key driver for longer waiting times for admission.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The patients who need longer stays are older with co-morbidities and complex conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The situation is aggravated by healthcare infrastructure projects being delayed due to COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are actively working on increasing acute bed capacity, community hospital bed capacity and Transition Care Facilities to address the capacity constraint.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For non-life-threatening patients who require admissions, hospitals will activate inpatient teams to start investigations and treatments in the EDs, even before a ward bed is available.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: If need be, we will tap on the capacity of private hospitals, as we did during COVID-19.

sections.label: Cause of care increase
sections.summary: The main cause of the increase is the increase in the complexity of care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The main cause of the increase is the increase in the complexity of care.

sections.label: Longer recovery, 15% increase
sections.summary: Patients are more unwell and take longer to recover, so 6.1 days to seven days is a 15% increase.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: They are more unwell and it takes longer for them to recover.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, 6.1 days to seven days is a 15% increase.
